readerCopy.body: A relationship or offer can look good from the outside and still ask you to keep part of yourself out of it. When Venus opposes Lilith, affection, money, chemistry, approval, or practical support can come with terms that make one important desire or boundary easier to hide than to negotiate. You can appreciate what the arrangement gives you and still admit what you have to give up to keep it. If staying loved, chosen, or supported repeatedly requires you to make the same part of yourself smaller, that cost belongs in the decision too. A good-looking arrangement is not automatically a good fit.
